hook.text: Shadow banks hold $63 trillion in assets. They do everything banks do except they're not regulated like banks.

buildup.text: Hedge funds, money market funds, and mortgage lenders operate outside traditional bank regulation.

discovery.text: Shadow banks funded the subprime mortgage boom. No reserve requirements. No deposit insurance. No oversight.

twist.text: When shadow banks collapsed in 2008, governments bailed them out anyway. Unregulated but too big to fail.

climax.text: The shadow banking system is bigger than traditional banking. Most people don't know it exists.

punchline.text: The biggest bank has no sign on the door.

quiz.question: What makes shadow banks different from traditional banks?
